verdict.what_is_wrong: A newly arrived stress-ng CPU workload added about one core of CPU demand and coincided with increased scheduler waits in other workloads; when it exited, CPU use and wait counts moved back toward their earlier levels. This is best classified as a subtle noisy neighbor, although the notes do not include the blueprint’s decisive per-victim “who ran while it waited” attribution or the rhythm/ceiling tests, so quota and wait attribution are not conclusively excluded.
